exposure: level of care of Obstetric Units
cohort: The cohort consisted of 168 women who underwent code red cesarean delivery between 2018 and 2021 at two level-2 University Hospitals and two level-1 Community Hospitals.
finding: Worse perinatal outcomes were independently associated with specific indications for code red cesarean delivery and with care provided in level-2 units.
mod_finding: Indications for code red cesarean delivery, but not the decision to delivery interval, were associated with worse perinatal outcomes.
